note: Verbatim copy of a third-party public catalogue, stored so the picker never depends on somebody else uptime and never reports our carriers route choices to them.
Kept byte-for-byte in their shape on purpose: an update is then a clean diff of this file rather than a re-derivation nobody can review.

Coverage is uneven for us and that is why app/data/payment_systems.json exists alongside it. Measured on the day it was fetched: 432 methods across 114 countries, but RU 0 entries, US 1, GE 0, BY 0, and neither Zelle nor Venmo nor any RU bank present at all. HodlHodl serves bitcoin P2P and does not operate in every market we fly to.

Legal footing is unsettled and named here rather than assumed: the endpoint is public and unauthenticated, but bulk extraction of a third-party database is a database-right and terms-of-service question, and the law applicable to this operator is itself still undecided (T4.0 section 0). Recorded as a decision of the owner, 2026-09-06.
